title: Cash falls short of a planned distribution
summary: Confirm what the governing agreement requires, decide with the right approvals, and tell investors plainly and early.

situation.trigger: Cash will not cover the distribution investors expect.

outlineSteps: Confirm the size of the shortfall and when it lands
Find the cause: vacancy, a tenant default, a rate reset or a capital item
Read what the governing agreement says about distributions
Check loan coverage and what the loan allows from reserves
Decide whether the shortfall is a one-time gap or a trend
List the options: reduce, defer, fund from reserves or skip
Test each option against the loan and the business plan
Decide with the approvals the governing agreement requires
Tell investors early, with the cause and the plan
Record the decision and update the forecast
